motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council instruct the City Administrative Officer, in consultation with Council District 14 and the City Attorney, to report on the establishment of a Sixth Street Viaduct Maintenance Trust Fund for the purpose of receipt, retention and disbursement of gifts, contributions, and donations for maintenance of the Sixth Street Viaduct, including trash and bulky item pickup, graffiti abatement, and other services.
